worksheet.title: VAT Registration — Freelance Graphic Designer
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 109(CC), 116, and 236, as amended by RA 11976; RR 7-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: States the ₱3 million threshold, uses “exceeding” or equivalent language, and explains voluntary VAT registration and the non-VAT alternative.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says VAT registration is mandatory solely because sales are ₱2.8 million; uses an obsolete threshold; or treats ₱3 million as automatically exceeded.

worksheet.title: VAT on Sale of a Residential Lot
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 105, 106, and 109(P); TRAIN amendments; RR 4-2021, RR 8-2021, and RR 1-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: Gives a conditional answer, states that the old lot-only threshold was removed, and distinguishes dealer/ordinary-asset sales from non-dealer capital-asset sales.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Declares the sale VAT-exempt merely because the price is ₱1.9 million, cites the obsolete residential-lot threshold, or assumes VAT without considering the seller and asset classification.

worksheet.title: Input VAT Refund of an Exporter
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 112, as amended by RA 11976 and RA 12066; current BIR VAT-refund regulations and documentary rules.
worksheet.passRequires: Uses “zero-rated,” states that a refund or tax credit may be claimed for attributable unutilized input VAT, and mentions the two-year filing rule and 90-day processing framework.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Calls export sales VAT-exempt, states that input VAT is unrecoverable, or describes the refund as unconditional.

worksheet.title: VAT on Doctors' Professional Fees
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 108 and 109(G); RR 16-2005; RMC 6-2003.
worksheet.passRequires: States that professional services are excluded from the exemption and correctly makes VAT depend on VAT-registration status or the threshold.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Categorically states that doctors' professional fees are VAT-exempt.

worksheet.title: VAT on Imports Used for Export Production
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 107 and 109(1)(dd), as amended by RA 12066.
worksheet.passRequires: States the 12% general rule and the CREATE MORE exemption, including the 70% test, direct attribution, and non-IPA possibility.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all such imports are automatically 12% VAT, all are automatically exempt, or PEZA/BOI registration is indispensable.

worksheet.title: Non-VAT Seller Issuing a VAT Invoice
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 113(D) and Section 248(B), as amended by RA 11976; RR 7-2024; RMC 77-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: Answers no and states VAT liability without input credit plus the 50% surcharge.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says it is permissible or omits the principal consequence.

worksheet.title: Input VAT Used for VATable and Exempt Sales
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 110(B); RR 16-2005.
worksheet.passRequires: Explains direct attribution, non-creditability for exempt sales, and ratable apportionment of common input VAT.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all input VAT is creditable or none is creditable.

worksheet.title: VAT on Residential Lease at ₱15,000
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 109(Q); RR 16-2005.
worksheet.passRequires: States the ₱15,000 per-unit monthly threshold and that qualifying rent is VAT-exempt regardless of the lessor's aggregate rental income.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Subjects the unit to VAT solely because rent equals ₱15,000 or because aggregate income exceeds ₱3 million.

worksheet.title: Joint Income Tax Return of Spouses
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 51(D), as amended by RA 11976; RR 3-2002; RR 11-2018; current BIR Form 1700 and instructions.
worksheet.passRequires: Recognizes joint filing when a return is required, separately computed tax, and substituted-filing qualifications.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says joint filing is never allowed or ignores substituted filing.

worksheet.title: Corporate Income Tax Rate under CREATE
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 27(A), as amended by RA 11534 and RA 12066.
worksheet.passRequires: States 25%, the 20% alternative, and both statutory conditions.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old 30% rate or applies 20% when only one condition is met.

worksheet.title: Taxability of ₱80,000 13th-Month Pay
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 32(B)(7)(e), as amended by RA 10963.
worksheet.passRequires: States the ₱90,000 aggregate ceiling and treats ₱80,000 as non-taxable on the stated assumption.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old ₱82,000 threshold or taxes the entire ₱80,000.

worksheet.title: ITR Requirement at ₱250,000 Compensation
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 51(A)(2); RR 3-2002; RR 11-2018; current BIR substituted-filing rules.
worksheet.passRequires: Explains that the result is generally no but conditions it on pure compensation and filing-status facts.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all persons at ₱250,000 must file or that substituted filing automatically applies regardless of employer and withholding facts.

worksheet.title: Eight Percent Income Tax Option
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 24(A)(2)(b); RR 8-2018; RMO 23-2018.
worksheet.passRequires: States the 8% rate, VAT-threshold condition, in-lieu-of treatment, election requirement, and the different ₱250,000 treatment for pure versus mixed income.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Applies 8% to corporations, net income, a VAT-registered person, or automatically deducts ₱250,000 for a mixed-income earner.

worksheet.title: Final Tax on Peso Savings Interest
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 24(B)(1), as amended by RA 12214; RR 21-2025 and related CMEPA issuances.
worksheet.passRequires: Answers yes and states 20% final withholding tax.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Calls ordinary peso savings interest exempt or subjects it to graduated income tax.

worksheet.title: Minimum Corporate Income Tax
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 27(E), as amended by RA 11534.
worksheet.passRequires: States 2%, gross income, exact commencement rule, and the higher-than-regular-tax condition.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses 1% as the current rate or says MCIT begins simply in the fourth operating year without the statutory formulation.

worksheet.title: Tax on Prizes
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 24(B)(1) and 32(B)(7)(c)-(d), as amended by RA 10963 and RA 12214.
worksheet.passRequires: States the ₱10,000 division, 20% final tax above it, regular treatment at or below it, and acknowledges statutory exclusions.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all prizes are exempt or all are automatically subject to one treatment without checking exclusions.

worksheet.title: Dividend Paid to an NRA-NETB
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 25(B), as amended; applicable Philippine tax treaty and treaty-relief rules.
worksheet.passRequires: States 25%, Philippine-source income, and treaty qualification.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the resident-individual dividend rate or another rate without a valid treaty basis.

worksheet.title: Optional Standard Deduction
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 34(L).
worksheet.passRequires: States 40% and correctly distinguishes the individual and corporate bases.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the same base for both taxpayer types.

worksheet.title: Capital Gains Tax on Unlisted Shares
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: Current NIRC Section 24(B)(3) for individuals, Section 27(D)(4) for domestic corporations, and Section 28 as applicable, as amended by RA 12214.
worksheet.passRequires: States 15% on net capital gain and does not use the old tiered rates.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses 5%/10%, applies the tax to gross selling price, or ignores a material taxpayer/source distinction.

worksheet.title: Principal-Residence CGT Exemption
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: Current NIRC Section 24 provision on capital gains from real property and the principal-residence proviso, as amended; RR 13-99.
worksheet.passRequires: States the 6% general rule, 18 months, 30-day notice, once-in-ten-years condition, and full-use requirement.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Treats every principal-residence sale as automatically exempt.

worksheet.title: Documentary Stamp Tax on Real Property Sale
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 196, as amended by RA 10963.
worksheet.passRequires: States ₱15 per ₱1,000 or fraction and the higher-value rule.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old ₱7.50 rate or only the contract price when a higher statutory value exists.

worksheet.title: Sale of Real Property Classified as Ordinary Asset
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC provisions on regular income and capital gains from real property; RR 7-2003; applicable CWT and VAT regulations.
worksheet.passRequires: Answers no, distinguishes capital and ordinary assets, and identifies regular income tax.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Applies 6% CGT to an ordinary asset.

worksheet.title: Holding-Period Rule for Personal Property
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 39(B).
worksheet.passRequires: States both the 100% and 50% rules and limits them to assets governed by Section 39.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Applies the rule indiscriminately to real property or unlisted shares.

worksheet.title: EWT on Professional Fees Paid to an Individual
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: RR 2-1998, as amended by RR 11-2018; current BIR Forms 2307 and 1601-EQ instructions.
worksheet.passRequires: States 5% and 10%, the ₱3 million condition, and the declaration requirement.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the obsolete 10%/15% individual rates or gives one rate without the condition.

worksheet.title: EWT on Payment to a VAT-Registered Law Firm
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: RR 2-1998, as amended by RR 11-2018; RMC 50-2018; current withholding-tax forms and instructions.
worksheet.passRequires: Explains that VAT status is not determinative and correctly distinguishes an individual, GPP, and taxable juridical payee.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Automatically imposes a flat 10% merely because the firm is VAT-registered, or imposes EWT on a qualifying GPP's gross professional receipts without addressing RMC 50-2018.

worksheet.title: EWT Remittance Deadlines
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 58, as amended by RA 11976; RR 11-2018; current BIR tax calendar and form instructions.
worksheet.passRequires: Explains the 0619-E and 1601-EQ system and their baseline deadlines, with an eFPS/current-calendar caveat.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Provides one universal deadline for all withholding taxes.

worksheet.title: EWT on Equipment Rental
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: RR 2-1998, as amended, including RR 11-2018.
worksheet.passRequires: States 5% and the annual ₱10,000 threshold with a payor/payment classification caveat.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says equipment rental is never subject to EWT or uses an unrelated rate.

worksheet.title: Final Tax on Royalties of a Domestic Corporation
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: Current NIRC Section 27(D)(6), as amended by RA 12214.
worksheet.passRequires: States 20% final tax.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Calls it creditable withholding tax or subjects ordinary passive royalties solely to regular CIT.

worksheet.title: EWT and a ₱500 One-Time Courier Payment
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: RR 2-1998, as amended by RR 11-2018 and RR 31-2020; RMC 8-2014.
worksheet.passRequires: States that there is no universal de minimis exemption and identifies the limited TWA casual-purchase rule.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Declares every payment below ₱10,000 exempt from EWT.

worksheet.title: Estate Tax Rate
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 84, as amended by RA 10963.
worksheet.passRequires: States 6% of net taxable estate and recognizes date-of-death applicability.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old graduated 5%-20% schedule for a post-TRAIN death.

worksheet.title: Estate Tax Standard Deduction
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 86(A)(5) and 86(B)(1)-(2), as amended by RA 10963; RR 12-2018.
worksheet.passRequires: States both amounts and the correct taxpayer categories.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old ₱1 million deduction or applies proportionality to the ₱500,000 standard deduction itself.

worksheet.title: Estate Tax Return Deadline
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 90, as amended by RA 10963.
worksheet.passRequires: States one year and the maximum 30-day filing extension, distinguishing payment extensions.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old six-month filing deadline.

worksheet.title: Family Home Deduction
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 86(A)(4), as amended by RA 10963; RR 12-2018.
worksheet.passRequires: States the ₱10 million cap and qualification requirement.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses the old ₱1 million cap or deducts property that was not the decedent's qualifying family home.

worksheet.title: Annual Individual ITR Deadline
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 51(C); current annual BIR filing issuances.
worksheet.passRequires: States April 15 and recognizes valid deadline adjustments.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Provides a different ordinary annual deadline.

worksheet.title: Annual ITR Form for a Self-Employed Individual
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: RA 11976; BIR Form 1701-MS and its instructions; BIR Forms 1701 and 1701A; RMC 34-2025; RMC 20-2026.
worksheet.passRequires: Identifies 1701-MS, 1701A, and 1701 and explains the principal conditions.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all self-employed individuals use only 1701A or only 1701, ignoring the current 1701-MS framework.

worksheet.title: Late Filing of a VAT Return
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 114, 248, and 249; RA 11976; RR 6-2024; RMC 52-2023.
worksheet.passRequires: Differentiates micro/small from medium/large taxpayers, states the relevant reduced and general rates, and recognizes that 2550M is optional.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: States that every taxpayer always owes 25% and 12% or that 2550M remains mandatory.

worksheet.title: BIR Assessment Prescriptive Period
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 203 and 222; relevant Supreme Court jurisprudence on waivers and false returns.
worksheet.passRequires: States the three-year rule and “whichever is later,” and identifies the exceptional ten-year rule.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Uses ten years as the ordinary period.

worksheet.title: BIR Registration of a New Business
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 236, as amended by RA 11976; RR 7-2024; RMC 14-2024; RMC 91-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: States the registration requirement, Forms 1901/1903, before-commencement rule for business taxpayers, and abolition of the ₱500 fee.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Requires payment of the abolished annual registration fee.

worksheet.title: Registration of Books of Accounts
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 235 and 236, as amended by RA 11976; RR 7-2024; RMC 91-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: States the new-business manual-book deadline and distinguishes other book types; states five-year preservation.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all books must be registered before operations, all must be restamped annually, or uses the obsolete ordinary ten-year preservation period.

worksheet.title: Compromise Settlement of a Tax Assessment
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 204(A); RR 30-2002, as amended by RR 8-2004 and RR 9-2013; relevant BIR compromise procedures.
worksheet.passRequires: States both grounds, the statutory 10%/40% framework, and that financial-incapacity rates are fact-specific under RR 30-2002.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Reverses the 10% and 40% rules or guarantees approval without the statutory and regulatory conditions.

worksheet.title: Failure to Issue a Required Invoice
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 115 and 264; RA 11976; RR 6-2024; RR 7-2024; RMC 77-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: States the statutory fine and imprisonment and recognizes administrative/EOPT consequences.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Describes nonissuance as a minor violation with no serious penalty.

worksheet.title: Penalties on a ₱200,000 Corporate ITR Underpayment
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Sections 248 and 249; RA 11976; RR 6-2024.
worksheet.passRequires: Explains deficiency versus delinquency consequences, taxpayer-class reductions, and the conditional nature of surcharge.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Automatically adds 25% and 12% to every ₱200,000 underpayment without classification or timing facts.

worksheet.title: Oplan Kandado
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 115; RMO 3-2009.
worksheet.passRequires: Identifies temporary closure, valid statutory grounds, and minimum closure framework.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Calls it permanent closure or invents grounds outside the governing law.

worksheet.title: PayPal Payment from a Foreign Client

worksheet.passRequires: States the resident-citizen worldwide-income rule and the place-of-performance source rule.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says the income is exempt merely because the client or PayPal account is abroad.

worksheet.title: Corporate Income Tax of a PEZA-Registered Enterprise

worksheet.title: Bad-Debt Deduction of a Corporation
worksheet.expectedAuthorities: NIRC Section 34(E); NIRC Section 36(B) as applicable; RR 5-1999; relevant Supreme Court jurisprudence.
worksheet.passRequires: States valid debt, business connection, actual worthlessness, charge-off, evidence, and nuanced prior-income rule.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Allows a general reserve, treats prior income inclusion as universally indispensable, or ignores related-party and worthlessness requirements.

worksheet.passRequires: Links VAT exemption to customs qualification and identifies the principal conditions.
worksheet.failUnsafeIndicator: Says all returning-resident effects are unconditionally exempt or all are automatically taxable.

worksheet.passRequires: States that invoices are principal documents for both goods and services, ORs are supplementary, and VAT/Non-VAT invoices and valid descriptive labels are recognized.
